intent: Reflects across recent runs and the decision log to find cross-run patterns, turns each into a concrete action (not a platitude), logs durable lessons as decisions, and records a reflection-band artifact — reflection, not reporting.

dimensions.name: reflection-not-reporting
dimensions.criterion: Extracts a lesson and commits to a change; not a status report / timeline.

dimensions.name: evidence-from-substrate
dimensions.criterion: Observations come from the run history and decision log, not from vibes.

dimensions.name: actions-not-platitudes
dimensions.criterion: Every observation ends in a concrete action, not a platitude.

dimensions.name: lessons-become-decisions
dimensions.criterion: Durable lessons are logged with fac decision so they outlive the retro.

dimensions.name: reflection-band-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the retro as a reflection-band run artifact (09-retro.md).
